cases.title: In a metre drawing (INSUNITS 6) a pit and a 20 m pipe are placed in metres and the pipe label reads 1 IN 200
cases.expected: With INSUNITS set to 6, a pit placed at 150,-80 and a pipe from 150,-80 to 170,-80 with inverts 18.000 and 17.900 give one pit and one pipe, and the pipe label reads '<size> DIA. <material> PIPE AT 1 IN 200' with its insertion point within 2 units of the middle 160,-80. A pipe that CE measured as 20000 long would read 1 IN 200000.
cases.why_not_unit: The drawing unit decides how every length and level is read; only a real drawing in metres shows it.
not_automated: INSUNITS 6 is SET by the driver on a millimetre master; a drawing that was authored in metres (pit blocks and text heights in metres) does not exist here, so the pit block scale is recorded, not judged.
Edit Pipe and the relink (CDSYNC) in metres (BUG-270, BUG-271, BUG-293, BUG-309, BUG-317, BUG-323, BUG-328, BUG-330, BUG-331, BUG-393) are not driven in this case.
